verdict.rationale: The evidence shows CoreWeave can create separate clusters via the Console, API, or Terraform, and that each cluster runs in its own VPC. That lets a user build an isolated test cluster themselves, but it is a general infrastructure building block. There is no documented sandbox, staging, or test-mode capability that guarantees testing without touching production data, so the story is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
